## LobbyCreateMatch: Create match (lobby modal)

Purpose: Pick crew size and difficulty, then join the queue; one obvious primary action.
ScreenGui: ScreenInsets CoreUISafeInsets, SafeAreaCompatibility None, DisplayOrder 30, modal (SelectionGroup, ButtonB = back)

States: closed, open, joining (initial closed)
- closed --open--> open (feel: ui_panel_open)
- open --close--> closed (feel: ui_panel_close)
- open --join--> joining (feel: ui_button_press)
- joining --cancel--> open
- joining --joined--> closed (feel: ui_panel_close)
- joining --close--> closed (feel: ui_panel_close)

Gamepad: default join, back panel.close; rows panel.close / p1, p2, p3 / diff_prev, diff_next / join

| device | px per design px | smallest text | smallest target |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | 1.000, 1.000 | 14 px (lbl_players) | 52 px (p1) |
| phone_notch | 1.000, 0.860 | 12 px (lbl_players) | 44.7 px (p1) |
| tablet | 1.398, 1.398 | 19.6 px (lbl_diff) | 72.7 px (p1) |
| pc | 1.160, 1.160 | 16.2 px (lbl_players) | 60.3 px (p1) |
| console | 2.275, 2.275 | 31.8 px (lbl_players) | 118.3 px (panel.close) |
